title: Biological State Sufficiency
finding: A proposed state must preserve the future law for the declared challenges.
role: Compare histories that share a reading; validate any extra measurement on new histories.
limit: A representational result does not identify a biological mechanism or treatment.

title: IDA and the Boundedness Engine
finding: Frozen-reference return, accumulated unresolved displacement and an addressed-update hypothesis.
role: Test recovery and corrective updating as distinct targets; preserve off-support follow-up.
limit: The device, neural bridges, and therapeutic effects remain unvalidated.

title: From Predictive State to Viable Action
finding: A useful distinction can be one that separates acceptable action sets.
role: Rank a probe by the decision it improves, including diagnostic cost and latency.
limit: A static action cover does not establish a recursively usable controller.

title: Repeated stress–recovery dataset
finding: Public physiological and task recordings support a first forecast screen.
role: Analysis 001: later task performance, person-held-out validation, ordinary history comparators.
limit: Thirty-four eligible people; this study contains no randomized IDA feedback.

title: AI guidance and physiological monitoring after experimental trauma
finding: A randomized intervention package reduced later intrusive memories; phase-specific pupil associations were exploratory.
role: Analysis 002 checks published outcomes and whether additional physiological predictors earn held-out value.
limit: Healthy volunteers and analogue trauma. Both arms used AI; pupil-contingent intervention was not tested.

title: Brief structured respiration practices
finding: A month-long trial compared brief breathwork with mindfulness; mood and respiratory-rate differences were reported.
role: Provides an existing candidate input for controlled research.
limit: Does not establish a universal target, IDA timing advantage, or lasting mental-health recovery.

title: Heart-rate variability biofeedback in substance use disorder
finding: A phase 2 trial of biofeedback added to usual treatment reported benefits in craving, negative affect, and substance-use outcomes.
role: Connect a physiological intervention with subsequent behavior, not only a changing sensor signal.
limit: A treatment-package comparison does not isolate adaptive timing or identify an individual's best input.

title: Personalized closed-loop treatment of depression
finding: Personalized intracranial mapping supported symptom-triggered stimulation with sustained improvement in one person.
role: Evidence that a specific state–intervention mapping can matter clinically.
limit: Invasive, individualized, n=1. It cannot be transferred to a noninvasive headband by analogy.

title: Micro-randomized trials
finding: Repeated randomization can estimate the proximal effects of adaptive-intervention components.
role: Use assigned action variation to test whether timing changes benefit.
limit: Requires suitable availability rules, outcomes, analysis, and management of carryover.

title: Finite redox rescue windows
finding: Recovery opportunity can depend on hidden supply and the depth and duration of challenge.
role: Design paired probes of demand, regenerative capacity, and later rescue in an independent cell model.
limit: This motivates a parallel biological test; it supplies no calibrated brain parameters or cancer therapy.

title: Response-coefficient attenuation of hormesis
finding: Large molecular induction need not create a large functional benefit.
role: Measure transmission to an independent endpoint and compare acute relief with later capacity.
limit: Model-dependent control coefficients must be measured in the same system.

title: Epistemic Type Safety for Generative AI
finding: Separate proposed claims, evidence binding, verification, and authority to act.
role: Keep numerical records, exploratory associations, simulations, and clinical claims in different categories.
limit: The app's finite record checker is not a natural-language proof system or a model-size benchmark.
